items.takeaway: GMK Salamander A keycap set inspired by resilience, craft, and the desire to leave a mark on the community we love. WEBSITE | DISCORD | INSTAGRAM • Website • Discord • Instagram IC FORM Click here to provide feedback Overview GMK Salamander is a Cherry profile keycap set designed by NyxKeys in collaboration with a close friend Glen. This project exists to create something meaningful within the mechanical keyboard hobby. Not as a tribute piece, but as a statement.
